title: AIZEN – CreditConnect-EV
summary: AIZEN reports that CreditConnect-EV financed more than 20,000 electric two-wheelers in Indonesia. Borrower income and net emissions effects are not measured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: AIZEN reports that CreditConnect-EV financed more than 20,000 electric two-wheelers in Indonesia. Borrower income and net emissions effects are unmeasured.
purpose: Use vehicle telemetry and risk scoring to expand electric-vehicle financing.

ratings.reason: The source reports financing more than 20,000 electric two-wheelers, representing improved access to an asset and financing. It does not establish higher borrower income or durable financial security.
The operating financing system supports lending for a previously difficult asset class at reported scale. Portfolio profitability and default improvement are not established.
Lower transport pollution is intended. Net emissions attributable to the financing program are unmeasured.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 3: AIZEN – CreditConnect-EV

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.

headline: CreditConnect-EV expands electric-motorcycle financing
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
